posts.meta_description:
25K likes, 304 comments - petermckinnon on September 5, 2026: "New Season, new profile. Twas’ time. Comin’ in hot ready to rock and roll! I’ve always enjoyed this time of year. In a way, it almost feels like the start of a new year heading into fall as much as the actual start of the new year. 😂 🍂

Spent some time hanging with my boy @alexandersworik who snapped these pics for me on a whim at his studio. Simple and effective. We’re especially stoked on that worn in breast pocket from this 70s wrangler denim shirt where some legend somewhere clearly kept his chewing tobacco 😂 The Canadian tuxedo if you will, felt like the right move. 🇨🇦

Who else thinks autumn is the goat of seasons? Right before it all goes to sh*t 😂🏴‍☠️🥶".

posts.meta_description:
9,777 likes, 66 comments - petermckinnon on August 16, 2026: "First slide, middle shot- that’s the inside of a vinyl cover if I’ve ever seen one 😱 Absolutely love it. It was too dark for the xpan during the show so I took the shot anyway with its near 3 second exposure and just physically panned right to create that drag. 

I did not expect it to turn out so epic. @cinestillfilm 800t was the move. Fired up on these! Analog strikes again. 💪🏻🫡🇮🇸

Dev & scan : @graination_official".

7,662 likes, 37 comments - petermckinnon on August 13, 2026: "Dressing room hangs with my bro @julius_son // We’ve got a few of these under our belts now- we’re always scheming something! Feels good to be creative with creative people. 

The post-show airway humidifier is always my fav. You can see my excitement 😂😂 I have collected many over the years. 🤿 

Portra 400 looked smooth and warm with the lights in this room. Very happy. When you have a friend with style like JJ, takin’ pics is eassssyyyyy.".
